events.title: Joan of Arc is captured at Compiègne
events.description: Leading a sortie from the besieged town, Joan was pulled from her horse by Burgundian troops. They sold her to the English, who had her tried for heresy and burned at Rouen a year later.
events.html: Leading a sortie from the besieged town, Joan was pulled from her horse by Burgundian troops. They sold her to the English, who had her tried for heresy and burned at Rouen a year later.

events.title: Defenestration of Prague sparks the Thirty Years' War
events.description: Protestant nobles threw two Catholic regents and their secretary from a window of Prague Castle; all three survived. The Bohemian revolt that followed grew into the Thirty Years' War.
events.html: Protestant nobles threw two Catholic regents and their secretary from a window of Prague Castle; all three survived. The Bohemian revolt that followed grew into the Thirty Years' War.

events.title: Captain William Kidd is hanged for piracy
events.description: Kidd, commissioned as a privateer by English backers, was hanged at Execution Dock in Wapping. Many historians think he was made a scapegoat to protect his powerful sponsors.
events.html: Kidd, commissioned as a privateer by English backers, was hanged at Execution Dock in Wapping. Many historians think he was made a scapegoat to protect his powerful sponsors.

events.title: South Carolina ratifies the US Constitution
events.description: South Carolina became the eighth state to ratify. New Hampshire's ratification a month later made nine, the number needed for the Constitution to take effect.
events.html: South Carolina became the eighth state to ratify. New Hampshire's ratification a month later made nine, the number needed for the Constitution to take effect.

events.title: Bonnie and Clyde are killed in a police ambush
events.description: Texas and Louisiana lawmen shot Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow in their car near Gibsland, Louisiana. The pair's gang had killed at least nine police officers.
events.html: Texas and Louisiana lawmen shot Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow in their car near Gibsland, Louisiana. The pair's gang had killed at least nine police officers.

events.title: Ben-Gurion announces the capture of Adolf Eichmann
events.description: Israel's prime minister told the Knesset that Eichmann, a principal organiser of the Holocaust, had been found and was in Israeli custody. Mossad agents had seized him in Argentina.
events.html: Israel's prime minister told the Knesset that Eichmann, a principal organiser of the Holocaust, had been found and was in Israeli custody. Mossad agents had seized him in Argentina.
